استعروا (form VIII)
# اِسْتَعَرُوا (istaʕarū) /is.ta.ʕa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# اُسْتُعِرُوا (ustuʕirū) /us.tu.ʕi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# اِسْتَعِرُوا (istaʕirū) /is.ta.ʕi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
